title: Back to the Black-Corner Region
summary: Medusa leaves Xiao Yan, Little Fairy Doctor and Zi Yan at the border of the Magical Beast Mountain Range, and Xiao Yan promises her the Heaven Soul Blood Fusing Pill within two years. Xiao Yan heads for Jia Nan Academy to find a Dou Zun, with a detour to an auction in Black Emperor City. On the way he saves Instructor Mai Di and her student Mo Ling from Demon Flame Valley killers. They tell him Elder Wu Hao and Xiao Yu are trapped in a valley with academy students. Wu Hao, the Bloody Sword, now a Dou Wang, holds off two Demon Flame Valley Dou Wangs and then their Fourth Elder, a Dou Huang. Xiao Yan arrives with the Heavy Xuan Ruler, saves Wu Hao and names himself Xiao Yan of the Xiao Gate. The Fourth Elder grabs students as hostages and runs.
